questions.text:
Choose ONE media genre. Write an essay discussing the extent to which you agree or disagree with ONE of the following statements, in relation to an aspect of your chosen media genre.

STATEMENTS (Choose ONE):
1. Audiences reward familiarity — the most popular texts within a genre follow well-established patterns.
2. Breaking genre rules is how individual texts become memorable.
3. Economic pressures mean that a genre will always favour safe formulas over experimentation.
4. A media genre adapts its conventions to suit new platforms and technologies.
5. Cultural context determines which genre conventions resonate with audiences at any given time.

You should aim to write a concise essay of no more than 4-5 pages. The quality of your writing is more important than the length of your essay. Make sure you respond only to your chosen statement throughout your essay, and support your discussion with evidence from a range of media texts and/or other sources, which may include your own production experience.

You must specify your chosen media genre and statement number on the planning page.
questions.markingGuide:
This is a holistic essay marked on a scale from N0 to E8.

WHAT YOU NEED TO INCLUDE:

For Achievement:
- Demonstrate understanding by identifying and describing an aspect of a specific media genre using detailed supporting evidence from a range of media texts within the genre, and/or other sources.
- Use detail from a range of media texts within the genre to support the description.
- Address the chosen statement throughout some (A3) or most (A4) of the essay.
- A4 describes in detail an aspect of a media genre.
- A4 may attempt to explain how and/or why the aspect has an impact on the media genre.

For Merit:
- Demonstrate in-depth understanding by giving reasoned explanations of an aspect of a specific media genre.
- A reasoned explanation involves a logical argument of how and/or why the aspect has an impact on the media genre, by responding to the chosen statement, using specific supporting evidence from a range of media texts within the genre, and secondary sources.
- Focus on the genre, using relevant evidence from a range of media texts within the genre, and/or other sources.
- Address the chosen statement throughout the essay.
- The explanation could cover: how and/or why changes in the media genre have occurred.
- how and/or why audience expectations and/or response to the media genre exist, or have developed.
- how and/or why commercial considerations influence the media genre.

For Excellence:
- Demonstrate critical understanding by examining the likely implications of an aspect of a specific media genre and drawing conclusions with supporting evidence from relevant secondary sources.
- Focus on the genre, using carefully selected evidence from secondary sources to support the discussion.
- E7 responds to the chosen statement with some nuance.
- E8 responds with nuance and shows an awareness of the complexities of the aspect for the media genre, media producers, or the audience.

EXPLANATION / WORKED EXAMPLE:

N0 = No response;.
no relevant evidence.
N1 = Shows limited understanding;.
OR genre not apparent;.
OR specific examples from texts are lacking.
N2 = Provides a limited description;.
OR does not address the chosen statement;.
OR provides some evidence, but not enough.
